items.statement: For every actual input pair and every common two-vector noise value, the source exact-gradient numerical phase obeys the M_kappa norm contraction with simultaneous explicit universal constant c=1/65536 under h Lambda_J<=c/kappa. The actual averaged Hessian and remainder are supplied by the independently compiled genuine algorithm producer, never assumed as a contraction/phase certificate.
assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra, including dimension zero. f:E->R is genuinely globally C2, kappa>=1, and (2kappa)^-1||v||²<=D²f(z)[v,v]<=||v||² for all z,v. This is the explicit normalized potential interface; actual V_eta construction is an independent producer.

J>=2,h>0. Actual nodes t_j=h/2(1-cos(j*pi/(J-1))), actual Lagrange cardinals ell_j, Lambda_J=sup_[0,h] sum|ell_j|, omega_ij=integral_0^{t_i}(t_i-s)ell_j(s)ds, b_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s)ds and c_j=integral_0^h(h-s)ell_j(s)ds. The sole step restriction is h Lambda_J<=1/(65536 kappa); h<=1 and h²Lambda<=1 are derived.

a=exp(-h/2), sigma=sqrt(1-exp(-h)). P0=a p+sigma zeta0; Y0_j=x+t_j P0; Y1_i=Y0_i-sum omega_ij gradient f(Y0_j); Phi=(x+hP0-sum c_j gradient f(Y1_j), a(P0-sum b_j gradient f(Y1_j))+sigma zeta1). This is the actual exact-gradient phase, shared synchronously at every input/noise pair, not only almost surely.
Q_kappa(x,p)=(1/(2kappa)+1/2)||x||²+inner(x,p)+||p||² and norm_M=sqrt(Q). The proof uses genuine Euclidean L2 phase norms throughout; it never treats the default product max norm as Euclidean.
